dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Oh? It's you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: *sniff* ...All clear! No scent of alcohol on you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hmph, adequate.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Well, the grass here isn't as soft as the spot where I usually take my afternoon nap.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: There aren't as many butterflies here as in the meadow I like to go to.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: And I can't hunt freely here like out in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll... look into making some improvements.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But... there's no smell of alcohol hanging in the air here...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...And no drunkards kicking up a fuss.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: So... I think we can keep it the way it is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Uhh, I'm actually pretty busy here!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: ...Still, I suppose a quick chat won't hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Let's do it — I know lots of great topics!

choices.text: Do you chat with other people a lot?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Well... the old drunkards try to chat with me all the time.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I never answer them, but that's still not enough to shut them up!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I always make a point of making them the most disgusting cocktail I can come up with.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But they drain every last drop and then ask for another glass! Ugh!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Why do things have to be this way...?

choices.text: What do you like to chat about?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...I like to share my hunting tips with others, but...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...The guys at the tavern only wanna talk about the harvest, girls they like, card game strategies... stuff like that.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I hate it. I make it pretty obvious that I'm not listening, but there's always someone at the bar rattling on to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #...Actually... there is something I wanted your help with, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: See, most of the time I'm either making cocktails or hunting, so I always tie my hair up like this.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: But... it's so relaxed here, there are no chores to do, plus nobody else has to see, soooo...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I was wondering... would it be better if I... wore my hair down...?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Well, in that case... could you help me with it?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...Wait! Firstly! I want to make it quite clear that this is not because I just enjoy the feeling of having my hair brushed, okay!? Ahem...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: And be gentle by the way. If you start tearing out hairs, hehe... I might just bite back!

choices.text: I'm sure wearing it down would look just as lovely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Diona.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hey, if you're going out for a bit of sunshine... and if you wanted to take me with you... I wouldn't mind!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Diona.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the grown-ups at the tavern would behave responsibly and go home after dark, like you.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Then I wouldn't have to be on duty all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hunting isn't easy, you know! You need the right techniques and weaponry.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Competent hunters go into the city every week to maintain their weapons, sometimes spending quite a bit of Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: With this smithy, ha! I can do maintenance myself.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Oh, how familiar... This place is very similar to my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: But you don't have any bars and drunkards here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Purrfect, hehe! I'll find a room to settle down in!
